end.parentNote: Ishaan practised classifying decimals and converting repeating decimals such as 0.333..., 0.555..., 0.1666..., and 0.4545... into fractions using multiplication and subtraction. They correctly used denominator factors to show that 7/20 terminates and converted it to 0.35. They mixed up the remainder steps while exploring 1/7; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise the long-division remainders for 1/7 and note the repeating block.
